System Architecture Overview

Quick guide to Powerful.jl's architecture for developers. Reading time: 15 minutes.

The Big Picture

The workflow:

  1. Parse - PSS/E RAW file → SystemModel (data only)
  2. Setup - Create ACPowerFlowProblem (picks formulation, variable layout)
  3. Solve - Newton iterations until convergence
  4. Extract - Results with user-friendly device IDs

Key principle: Data structures don't know about solvers. Solvers don't know about topology.

Architectural Layers

Layers build bottom-up. Each layer knows nothing about layers above it.

Foundation Layer (src/foundation/)

Defines:

  • AbstractModel - Base type for all device models
  • ModelMetadata - What variables, residuals, parameters each model has
  • FormulationTrait - PowerInjection, CurrentInjection, etc.
  • AddressType - AlgebVar, StateVar, AlgebRes, etc.

Changes rarely - These are fundamental abstractions.

Indexing Layer (src/indexing/)

Maps between three coordinate systems:

  1. External IDs → Bus 4001, 4002 (user-facing, from file)
  2. Internal indices → 1, 2, 3... (contiguous array positions)
  3. DAE addresses → y[42], g58

Two mappers:

  • IndexOrder - External → Internal
  • AddressManager - Internal → DAE

Why separate: Different formulations have different variables. AddressManager must be created per-problem, not stored in system data.

Model Layer (src/models/)

Each device type (PQ load, PV generator, Branch):

  • Struct definition (pure data, no methods)
  • Metadata (variables, residuals, parameters)
  • Residual kernels (compute power injections or currents)

No cross-references in struct fields. Models declare dependencies via metadata. System retrieves these during setup.

System Layer (src/system/)

SystemModel contains:

  • Model collections (StructArrays)
  • External-to-internal index mappings
  • Per-unit conversion coefficients
  • Original parsed data (optional)

No computational state - No DAE vectors, no Jacobians. Those live in workspaces.

Problem Layer (src/solvers/)

ACPowerFlowProblem specifies:

  • Which SystemModel to solve
  • Which formulation (PowerInjection vs CurrentInjection)
  • Variable ordering strategy (NaturalAddressing vs AMDAddressing)

Creates AddressManager - Assigns every variable/residual to specific DAE vector positions.

Solver Layer (src/solvers/)

Sets up workspaces and runs iterations:

  1. Create ADCache for automatic differentiation
  2. Allocate sparse Jacobian with correct sparsity pattern
  3. Initialize ResidualBuffers for each model type
  4. Iteration loop:
    • Evaluate residuals
    • Compute Jacobian
    • Solve linear system
    • Update state
    • Check convergence

Delegates physics to workspaces - Solver does numerical methods only.

Core Design Principles

Separation of Data from Computation

  • SystemModel = data only, no computation
  • Workspaces = computation, read from system
  • Benefit: Create multiple problems (different formulations) from same system

Metadata-Driven Modeling

  • Models declare interface via ModelMetadata
  • System introspects metadata to allocate variables
  • Benefit: Add new models without modifying core code

Type Stability Everywhere

  • Concrete types, type parameters throughout
  • NamedTuples (not Dicts) for workspaces
  • Functions like T<:Number support ForwardDiff.Dual
  • Benefit: Compiler optimizations, zero runtime checks

Zero Allocation in Hot Paths

  • Newton loop allocates nothing after setup
  • Residual eval reuses buffers
  • Jacobian reuses sparsity patterns
  • Benefit: Fast iterations, no GC pauses

Formulation as First-Class Concept

  • Different formulations = different types (PowerInjection, CurrentInjection)
  • Not config options or special cases
  • AddressManager is formulation-specific
  • Benefit: Add new formulations without touching existing code

Composition Over Inheritance

  • Multi-island systems = Vector{SystemModel}
  • GPU arrays = type parameters, not subclasses
  • Benefit: Natural extensibility

Data Flow

1. Parsing (PowerFlowData.jl)

case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
# Returns structured data (buses, branches, loads, generators)

2. System Construction

sys = SystemModel(case)

Steps:

  • ext2int - Map external bus numbers to internal indices
  • Retrieve external parameters (base voltages, bus types)
  • Convert to per-unit (MW, kV → pu)
  • Store coefficients for inverse conversion

3. Problem Creation

prob = ACPowerFlowProblem(sys, PowerInjection())

Steps:

  • Create AddressManager
  • Assign addresses based on formulation
    • PowerInjection: θ, V per bus
    • CurrentInjection: Vr, Vi per bus
  • Detect islands (creates separate problems if needed)

4. Workspace Setup

ws = setup_powerflow_newton(prob)

Steps:

  • Build ADCache with ResidualBuffers for each model
  • Pre-allocate arrays (variable values, residual values, addresses)
  • Compute Jacobian sparsity pattern
  • Set up matrix coloring for efficient AD
  • Initialize DAE vectors: y (variables), g (residuals)
  • Flat start: θ=0, V=1.0

5. Iteration

Each Newton step:

  1. Gather - Copy y → local buffers using addresses
  2. Compute - Each model's kernel computes residuals
  3. Scatter - Copy local buffers → g using addresses
  4. Jacobian - AutoDiff computes ∂g/∂y
  5. Solve - J·Δy = -g (sparse linear solve)
  6. Update - y += Δy
  7. Check - Converged if ||g|| small enough

6. Result Extraction

v = get_var(sol, :Bus, :v, (4001,))  # Get voltage for bus 4001
df = collect_model_table(sol, :Bus)   # All bus data as DataFrame

Automatic conversion: Per-unit → physical units (kV, MW, MVAR)

Extension Points

New Device Models

Implement:

  1. Struct inheriting AbstractModel
  2. ModelMetadata (variables, residuals, parameters)
  3. Residual kernels for each formulation
  4. Register with @register_model

System handles everything else automatically.

New Formulations

Implement:

  1. New FormulationTrait type
  2. Add model_metadata methods specifying variables
  3. Implement calc_residuals! for each model

AddressManager and workspaces handle the rest.

New Addressing Strategies

Implement:

  1. Create AddressingStrategy subtype
  2. Implement address assignment algorithm

Pass to ACPowerFlowProblem constructor.

New Solver Algorithms

Implement:

  1. Create workspaces
  2. Run your iteration method

Reuse ResidualBuffers and AD infrastructure.

New Result Access Patterns

Add convenience functions in src/io/results.jl:

  • Call get_var and get_ext_indices in useful combinations
  • Solution object gives raw data via problem/system references
